title: Right limits upload (BOW front end, RIGHT_LIMITS)
purpose: Order and exposure limits per client, category, exchange, market and segment (maximum order quantity and value, turnover, exposure, buy and sell amounts), from the firm's right limit lines in Connections → BOW upload files, for each active client with the category open; new or changed clients since the last file. BOW's samples end some lines with an extra comma (27 fields); Ledgerline writes 26. BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.

columns.name: Client ID/ Dealer ID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC

columns.name: USERLEVEL
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. USER (user level) or Group

columns.name: Category
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Securities or COMMODITIES (blank in one of BOW's samples)

columns.name: EXCHANGE
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. BSE, NSE, MCX, NCDEX

columns.name: MARKET
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. EQ, CUR, CF …

columns.name: SEGMENT
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. EQ …; blank in some of BOW's samples
